subject: Request: full operational matrix & egress map for new subprocessor
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Laura Ng <laura.ng@syncstream.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 14:13:00 -0700
Subject: Request: full operational matrix & egress map for new subprocessor

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of FinClient's final security review (they're requesting one consolidated artifact), can you send: 

- A single operational matrix that lists all SyncStream subprocessors/subcontractors, their roles (processing, logging, CDN, analytics), and the countries where they operate.
- An egress/dataflow map (PDF) showing where customer-origin data may egress to (including any third countries).
- Any SOC2/ISO attestation links for the new subprocessor (if available).

FinClient specifically called out: retention controls, KMS boundaries, and whether any KV/AI caching is routed through third parties. If SyncStream has an internal point-of-contact (name/email) for procurement/security evidence, please add them to the reply so we can consolidate.

We'd like to circulate the artifacts to FinClient's procurement/security teams by Monday morning (PST). Appreciate if you can attach the files or share a Drive link.

Best,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Partner Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: template_request_checklist.txt (txt)]

From: Laura Ng <laura.ng@syncstream.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: SyncStream Security Team <security@syncstream.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: full operational matrix & egress map for new subprocessor

Connor —

Thanks for the note and the checklist. Attaching the operational matrix and an egress map (first-pass). A couple of clarifications included inline below.

Summary of attachments:
- syncstream_operational_matrix_v1.xlsx (breaks out Tier-1/Tier-2 subprocessors and their role)
- egress_map_visual.pdf (high-level flow; legends for cross-border hops)
- syncstream_soc_links.txt (links to our latest SOC2 report and subprocessor attestations)

Clarifications:
- Our CDN partner (EdgeWave CDN) caches content in edge PoPs across EU/US/APAC; cache keys never contain raw payloads — only hashed identifiers.
- Analytics vendor (Statly) receives aggregated telemetry; no PII should flow.
- We have a KMS partition for customer keys. However, for ephemeral KV caching we rely on a managed cache provider that performs encryption at rest but uses SyncStream-managed keys (not customer KMIP).

POC for evidence: me (Laura Ng) + security lead security@syncstream.io — I've cc'd them.

If FinClient needs full configuration-level logs or an architecture diagram that drills into the transit paths (per-customer), that will be a short-request to our infra team; can you confirm whether they want per-tenant egress paths or the high-level map?

Regards,
Laura Ng
Head of Compliance Operations, SyncStream
[Attachments: syncstream_operational_matrix_v1.xlsx (xlsx), egress_map_visual.pdf (pdf), syncstream_soc_links.txt (txt)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Ng <laura.ng@syncstream.io>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: full operational matrix & egress map for new subprocessor

Thanks Laura — the artifacts look good as a starting point. A few follow-ups before we send to FinClient: 

1) Can SyncStream confirm whether any KV/cache snapshots or metrics buckets are ever exported to a US-based analytics partner outside of the KMS partition described? If yes, list which buckets and retention periods.

2) FinClient will ask for a DPA redline to confirm subprocessor notification clauses and a 30-day advance notice for any changes. Can you attach your current DPA redline (or a sample)?

3) We need a named technical POC who can approve a short evidence package (logs + config snips) within 48 hours if requested by FinClient's security team. Please provide name, role, and email.

If you can provide the answers and the DPA redline by EOD today (PST), we can include everything in the procurement packet and push to DocuSign.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: subprocessor_dpa_redline.docx (docx)]

From: Laura Ng <laura.ng@syncstream.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: SyncStream Security Team <security@syncstream.io>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: full operational matrix & egress map for new subprocessor

Kim, Connor —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers below and attaching our DPA redline.

1) KV/cache exports: We do export aggregated metric buckets to Statly (US region) for cross-customer analytics; those exports never contain PII and are retained for 90 days. I have called this out in row 7 of the matrix.

2) DPA redline: attaching syncstream_dpa_redline_v2.docx. We can accept a 30-day notification window but would like to keep emergency patching carve-outs (48 hours) for security-critical switchover. We marked that clause in the redline comments.

3) Technical POC: Miguel Santos (Sr. Infra Engineer) miguel.santos@syncstream.io — authorized to approve infra evidence packages.

Attachments: syncstream_dpa_redline_v2.docx, plus the matrix/map already sent. We'll also share a Drive folder with the original config snippets if FinClient asks for them.

I'll upload the Drive link and the DocuSign packet later this morning.

Best,
Laura
[Attachments: syncstream_dpa_redline_v2.docx (docx)]
